{{Quote|Cademimu Five is an industrial world used by the Republic as a weapons depot&mdash;the so-called "war chest of the Outer Rim."|[[Darth Malgus]]|<ref name="TOR-IntroCademimu" />}}
'''Cademimu V''', also simply referred to as '''Cademimu''', was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Cademimu sector/Legends|Cademimu sector]] along the [[Celanon Spur/Legends|Celanon Spur]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Cademimu Five <nowiki>=</nowiki> industrial ecumenopolis // Population <nowiki>=</nowiki> ten billion. Notable features <nowiki>=</nowiki> planetary missile batteries + ordnance stockpiles // Weaponry purpose <nowiki>=</nowiki> distribution to neighboring Republic systems in event of war.|[[S0-M1]]|<ref name="TOR-IntroCademimu" />}}
Cademimu V was an [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]]<ref name="TOR-IntroCademimu" /> located in the [[Cademimu sector/Legends|Cademimu sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was a major trade world located on the [[Celanon Spur/Legends|Celanon Spur]] hyperlane<ref name="TOR-CademimuFive" /> and was heavily industrialized.<ref name="TOR-IntroCademimu" /> The planet was also known for its strong military tradition.<ref name="TOR-CademimuFive" />

==History==
{{Quote|..the Republic entrusts Cademimu Five with missile stockpiles, but not financial support; the Senate asks me to prepare this world for war, then calls me corrupt! My fellow Cademimans, you've suffered these political games long enough. My duty as governor is to protect you--so as of today, I am declaring independence of the Republic and declaring its weapons our own.|Governor [[Chornarov]]|<ref name="TOR-Cademimu" />}}
Cademimu V was first colonized as an obscure waypoint for military patrols. However, the population increased strongly with the discovery of the Celanon Spur and the planet evolved as a trade hub. Cademimu later acquired strategic importance and served as a major munitions depot for [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces. During the [[Great Galactic War]], its missile stores were depleted twice but they were rebuilt larger after that. By the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] it had earned the nickname "The War-Chest of the Outer Rim."<ref name="TOR-CademimuFive" />

[[File:Cademimu_uprising.png|thumb|left|200px|The [[Cademimu uprising]].]]
During the Cold War, Cademimu's corrupt governor [[Chornarov]] took control of the planet with the help of the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] and declared the world independent. This event was not welcomed by the civilian population, leading to riots. Both the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] then sent strike forces on Cademimu. The Republic sought to retake control of the missile defense system while the Empire tried to exploit the situation at the same time. During the [[Cademimu uprising|fighting]], Mantellian [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ortol]] was killed and Chornarov was removed from power.<ref name="TOR-Cademimu" />

By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Cademimu system had become a [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]].<ref name="TEA" />
